answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a tide against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. Like a stone jetty blocking chaotic waves, this economic barrier forces attackers to acquire substantial network tokens, preventing the ivory tower of centralized control. The cost of an attack scales linearly with the total staked value, making the creation of multiple fake-identity agents economically irrational as it dilutes the attacker’s own collateral.
